items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: heard Bessie Smith or her sister Mamie Smith.

ctx.x: No. My influences came from, I didn’t hear them at all until later on in the years. Because they started like talking about them. I don’t know exactly what year, but no. I had never
heard Bessie Smith or her sister Mamie Smith. The only one that I remember is “L’il Green.” [sings] In the dark it’s just you and I. You remember that?
